duration: About 6 hours of online work, then in-person sessions (Spring 2026 courses ran March 30 to April 2)
pay_detail: Training is free. City of Durham pool lifeguard jobs started at $18.90 an hour on the outdoor pools page.
name: Durham Aquatic School (free lifeguard certification)
what_you_do: Free American Red Cross lifeguard training (worth $209). It covers CPR/AED and first aid. Graduates can apply for lifeguard jobs at Durham's indoor and outdoor pools.
who_can_apply: Applicants must be at least 16 years old (bring proof of age to the pre-course swim test). The page also says candidates must be at least 15 on or before the last class session, so ask which rule applies. You must pass the pre-course swim test: a 150 yard swim-tread-swim, then a timed event with a 10 pound object retrieved from 7 to 10 feet deep.
deadline_text: Spring 2026 course: pre-course swim test Sunday, March 15, registration deadline March 15 at 10 am. New dates are posted each season.
how_to_apply: Sign up online at dprplaymore.org (Register Online). Or sign up in person at any Durham Parks and Recreation site. Then pass the swim test before the course. Apply for lifeguard jobs on the City of Durham career page.
notes: Search ActiveNet for DAS for current dates. Space is limited and filled by order of pre-course test registration. Questions: DPRAquatics@durhamnc.gov, 919-560-4444. Whether teens under 18 need NC working papers was not checked.
